human_text: Lolley nearly puts Forest ahead inside the opening minute — a deflected effort from six yards goes agonisingly wide after Grabban's header back across goal.
Downing tests Samba with a low drive from 20 yards — Blackburn's first real attempt of the evening.
Grabban volleys straight at Walton from the edge of the area — a good chance wasted for the Forest striker.
Armstrong finally gets his reward! He bursts through the Forest defence, Worrall can only block his initial effort but the striker fires the rebound past Samba from a tight angle. Blackburn lead 1-0!
Forest hit back immediately! Lolley picks up the ball 25 yards out, nobody closes him down and he unleashes a shot into the bottom corner. 1-1!
Adomah fails to capitalise on Carvalho's through ball — the winger is through on goal but somehow fails to get a shot away.
